geometry_protocol.determinant_units: UV squared per original area normalized by mesh.scale squared
geometry_protocol.contact_coordinate_units: normalized atlas UV; exact original identity required
geometry_protocol.shape_weights: original 3D face area / total original 3D face area
geometry_protocol.shape_p95_definition: left weighted quantile at cumulative original area 0.95
geometry_protocol.shape_tail_definition: area-weighted worst 0.05 mass; fractional boundary face
geometry_protocol.intersection_arithmetic: GEOS floating precision; no snapping or area cutoff
geometry_protocol.guarantee_scope: checked finite-precision state; no exact-arithmetic or global bijection proof

geometry.independent_orientation_policy: constant signed chart; declared group orientation enforced

source_uv_preservation.note: Existing local layout only; new pairs or changed pair layouts remain rejected. Source conflicts are not counted as deliberate reuse or strict validation success.

render.contract: fixed original-mesh z-buffer; 2x2 screen supersampling; unlit BaseColor only

seams.contract: authoritative original-edge plus current-seam residual jump and each-side absolute reconstruction gates; exact UV/source-continuous unmodified edges use shared-sample identity

profile.reference_filter: source-only chart-aware piecewise-affine footprint: (2*2^LOD)^2 BOX quadrature then bilinear
profile.reference_boundary: traverse current chart faces; nearest same-chart boundary extension
profile.render_reference: fixed screen 2x2 source-signal supersampling, independent of atlas resolution and LOD
profile.scope: finite surface/color/seam/unlit-CPU probes; not full PBR, GPU, or continuous bounds
